correctness.rationale: Strict local outward opinion sums on the K4-portal chain force clipped opinions to their ±1 corners in a neighborhood; exact disease-free vaccination balances follow. The smooth remaining Jacobian has infection block 1−alpha+lambda A_MM, plus decaying pro-community and vaccination modes. Symmetry of A_MM yields the strict spectral stability/instability tests. Perron symmetry reduces each negative clique run to a path eigenvalue t_l, giving r_l exactly. End-of-word decomposition gives the recurrence; the strict four-clique inequality has an exact radical certificate. The equality case is excluded; finite verifier checks only examples.

originality.rationale: The motivating full model gives the coupled clipping/MMCA equations and a fully anti-vaccine invasion calculation but no classification of simultaneous partially vaccinated strict pinned disease-free equilibria on a chain of cliques. Preceding majority-partition constructions already show exponentially many stable opinion partitions, and heterogeneous SIS vaccination theory already provides general spectral criteria: neither ingredient alone is claimed new. The combined exact K4-chain Perron formula, run-length classification and equal-coverage opposite-stability witness were compared directly with their claims and not located in the checked materials. Related two-layer SAIS work has different dynamics; its full text remains inaccessible and is a residual risk.
residual_risks: Possible unindexed specialized graph-spectral enumeration or exact corner-stability analysis of the same clipped SIV map.
A broader general theorem combining pinned social states and epidemic reproduction criteria could imply the present special graph-family result.
Zhai et al. 2026 accessible abstract reports multiple equilibria but publisher full text was unavailable; distinct SAIS/media coupling lowers, but does not eliminate, prior-overlap risk.

value.rationale: The source studies how heterogeneous topology and pro/anti-vaccination opinions affect epidemic thresholds, but aggregate vaccine uptake does not encode location. The exact attracting-state classification over arbitrarily long community chains and the four-community pair with identical vaccine coverage but opposite local invasion stability answer that motivated structural question. The nontrivial input is a coupling of exact strict clipping, finite-cluster Perron eigenvalues and a run-avoidance enumerator; neither a generic local Jacobian check nor a previously known opinion-gadget count is presented as independently valuable novelty.
